remarks:
Opportunity to acquire a 10 unit investment portfolio consisting of seven parcels strategically located throughout Jamestown, Lakewood, and Falconer, NY. The portfolio includes a combination of single-family and multi-family properties, offering an attractive opportunity for investors looking to expand an existing rental portfolio or establish a diversified investment package. This package includes two single family houses - one located in Lakewood and two side by side duplexes which are rare!!

The portfolio includes 3 Strong St., Jamestown; 216 Elmcrest Ave., Lakewood; 225 Weeks St., Jamestown; 101 E. Main St., Falconer; 212 Front St., Jamestown; and 37 Maple St., Jamestown, with 212 Front St. consisting of two parcels.

The properties offer a variety of investment opportunities, including multi-family properties with multiple living units, a single-family ranch in Lakewood, and additional residential properties throughout the Jamestown and Falconer areas. Several properties feature separate utilities, garages or additional parking, basements, porches, and other features attractive to rental investors.

3 Strong St., Jamestown offers 3 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, approximately 1,348 square feet, a full basement, porch, and patio.

216 Elmcrest Ave., Lakewood is a 2-bedroom, 1-bath ranch offering approximately 952 square feet, a full basement, carport, covered front porch, hardwood flooring, and a double lot.

225 Weeks St., Jamestown is a two-family property offering approximately 1,944 square feet, two 1-bedroom/1-bath units, a two-car garage, separate gas and electric meters, and hardwood flooring.

101 E. Main St., Falconer is a two-family property offering approximately 2,544 square feet with two 3-bedroom apartments and separate utilities.

212 Front St., Jamestown is a multi-family property offering approximately 2,992 square feet on approximately 0.35 acres and is represented by two parcels.

37 Maple St., Jamestown is a spacious two-unit property offering approximately 2,588 square feet, four bedrooms and two bathrooms, a full basement, and garage.
